## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid twenty-year-old youth. He has a round, expressionless face and demonstrates a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a big, stolid youth of twenty with a round, expressionless face. He possesses a painful lack of conversational gifts, making him notably uncommunicative.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## History

Billy Andrews initially served as a driver for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends, driving them home after a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). After his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, clearing the way for him to marry, his shy nature led his sister Jane to propose to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on his behalf. [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined the proposal, prompting Jane to note that Billy would likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane.md)

Jane is Billy's sister. Due to Billy's extreme shyness, Jane acts as his intermediary, going so far as to deliver a marriage proposal to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf during an overnight stay. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejects the offer, Jane accepts the decision coolly and notes that her brother will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) is Billy's sister, and the two often socialized with the same local youth group. Billy occasionally acts as an escort for Jane and her friends, such as driving Jane, [Anne](../character/anne.md), and [Diana](../character/diana.md) home following a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Knowing how shy Billy is, Jane takes it upon herself to propose to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on his behalf, though she accepts Anne's refusal without conflict.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013)</sub>

### [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Nettie is identified as Billy's likely future spouse. Following [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's refusal of Billy's marriage proposal, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) observes that her brother will probably marry Nettie instead.

- Spouse of — married (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
